description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Decline a booking request

Declines a booking that waits for the host (status `pending`). The optional `reason` is handed to the calendar provider, which may show it to the attendee. Only calendars with booking requests support this (Cal.com). The others answer 422 `not_supported`.

body.description: Optional `reason`, at most 500 characters. An empty object or no body declines without a reason.

bookingId.description: The `id` of the booking as GET /integrations/bookings returns it.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.

name: decline_booking
title: Decline a booking request
